title: Grumpy Bookstore Owner
goal: Maximize satisfied customers using one contiguous calm interval.
strategy: Count naturally satisfied customers once. Slide a window over only otherwise-lost customers and add the best recoverable amount to that baseline.

phasePurposes.start: Maximize satisfied customers using one contiguous calm interval.

phasePurposes.done: Maximize satisfied customers using one contiguous calm interval.

edgeCases: Nobody was grumpy, so recovery adds nothing
